# wasabi_bucket_lifecycle_configuration (Resource)

Manages the lifecycle rules of a bucket. Do not use it together with the inline `lifecycle_rule` blocks of `wasabi_bucket` on the same bucket, because the two would overwrite each other's configuration. Because `wasabi_bucket` removes lifecycle rules that are not in its own configuration, add `ignore_changes = [lifecycle_rule]` to the `lifecycle` block of the bucket. Wasabi has no storage classes, so transitions are not supported, and tag filters are not supported either.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "wasabi_bucket" "example" {
  bucket = "example-bucket"

  # The bucket resource removes lifecycle rules that are not in its own
  # configuration, so leave them to wasabi_bucket_lifecycle_configuration.
  lifecycle {
    ignore_changes = [lifecycle_rule]
  }
}

resource "wasabi_bucket_versioning" "example" {
  bucket = wasabi_bucket.example.id

  versioning_configuration {
    status = "Enabled"
  }
}

resource "wasabi_bucket_lifecycle_configuration" "example" {
  bucket = wasabi_bucket.example.id

  rule {
    id     = "expire-logs"
    status = "Enabled"

    filter {
      prefix = "logs/"
    }

    expiration {
      days = 30
    }
  }

  rule {
    id     = "clean-up"
    status = "Enabled"

    noncurrent_version_expiration {
      noncurrent_days = 7
    }

    abort_incomplete_multipart_upload {
      days_after_initiation = 1
    }
  }

  depends_on = [wasabi_bucket_versioning.example]
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `bucket` (String) The name of the bucket.
- `rule` (Block List, Min: 1) The lifecycle rules. A rule needs at least one of `expiration`, `noncurrent_version_expiration` and `abort_incomplete_multipart_upload`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--rule))

### Optional

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--rule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rule`

Required:

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the rule.
- `status` (String) Whether the rule is applied, `Enabled` or `Disabled`.

Optional:

- `abort_incomplete_multipart_upload` (Block List, Max: 1) Aborts multipart uploads that are not completed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--rule--abort_incomplete_multipart_upload))
- `expiration` (Block List, Max: 1) Expires the current version of the objects. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--rule--expiration))
- `filter` (Block List, Max: 1) Limits the rule to the objects with a key prefix. Without it, the rule applies to all objects. Tag filters are not supported: tags in a filter that was created elsewhere are ignored and removed when this resource updates the rule. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--rule--filter))
- `noncurrent_version_expiration` (Block List, Max: 1) Expires noncurrent object versions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--rule--noncurrent_version_expiration))

<a id="nestedblock--rule--abort_incomplete_multipart_upload"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rule.abort_incomplete_multipart_upload`

Required:

- `days_after_initiation` (Number) The number of days after the upload was initiated after which it is aborted.


<a id="nestedblock--rule--expiration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rule.expiration`

Optional:

- `date` (String) The date after which the objects expire, as a timestamp at midnight UTC such as `2030-01-01T00:00:00Z`. It cannot be combined with `days`.
- `days` (Number) The number of days after creation after which the objects expire. It cannot be combined with `date`.
- `expired_object_delete_marker` (Boolean) Whether to remove delete markers that have no noncurrent versions. It cannot be combined with `date` or `days`.


<a id="nestedblock--rule--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rule.filter`

Optional:

- `prefix` (String) The key prefix that objects must have.


<a id="nestedblock--rule--noncurrent_version_expiration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rule.noncurrent_version_expiration`

Required:

- `noncurrent_days` (Number) The number of days after which a version becomes noncurrent before it expires.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import wasabi_bucket_lifecycle_configuration.example example-bucket
```
